messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: Arcelle (preview cohort) hasn't completed their enablement onboarding. Only 1 of 4 seats active. They reported 'confusing mapping' in the survey.
Ben: Do we have the mapping screenshots?
Aisha: Yes attached in the support ticket (link) but customer also mentioned they tried the sample loader and got null vectors.
Ravi: Null vectors usually mean malformed CSV or wrong delimiter. Can we ask for the first 5 rows?
Aisha: I'll request a 5-row sample and ask them to confirm delimiter and encoding.
Nora: Suggestion: propose a 45-min remote pairing session (we'll do schema mapping + quick validation).
Ben: Who's available for pairing? I can take Mon morning PST.
Ravi: I can do Tue afternoon PST. If we need an engineer in the call, I can carve out 1 hour.
OnboardBot: Reminder: cohort health flagged for Arcelle - tag set to high-touch.
Aisha: Plan: 1) request sample 2) schedule pair session 3) provision temporary CSV ingestion job if needed 4) follow-up 2 weeks after activation to capture feedback.
Ben: Add: ask them about success metric for preview (e.g., retrieval accuracy or latency).
Aisha: Good call. I'll add to the pre-call checklist.
Nora: Also adding a short post-session survey to capture whether the mapping docs were sufficient. Keep it 3 quick Qs.
Ravi: If mapping fails we can run a one-off transform for $X effort estimate. I'll text the cost estimate privately.
Aisha: I'll coordinate scheduling and loop in AE (Kelsey) if they don't respond in 48h.
Ben: Marking renewal risk = low for now but bump to medium if no activation by EOW.
Aisha: Cool. I'll ping this thread when we have the sample. :wave:
